themes_detail.label: Dead trees and animal carcasses spike
themes_detail.summary: This week, Sunset Park experienced a dramatic surge in dead/dying tree complaints (9 this week vs. 1.5 weekly average, +500%) and dead animal reports (6 this week vs. 1.1 weekly average, +433%), suggesting a possible environmental event, pest outbreak, or disease affecting the district's green infrastructure and wildlife.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 9 this week vs. 1.5 weekly average (z-score 5.3, +500%)
Dead Animal complaints: 6 this week vs. 1.1 weekly average (z-score 4.63, +433%)
Both spikes concentrated in same week, suggesting correlated environmental trigger
reporting_angles: Investigate whether a single environmental event (storm, pest, disease) caused both spikes; interview Parks Dept and arborists
Map complaint locations to identify if spike is geographically concentrated in specific parks or neighborhoods within CD 307

themes_detail.label: Bike rack infrastructure crisis
themes_detail.summary: This week, bike rack complaints spiked to 4 complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average (+1500%), indicating possible coordinated damage, theft, or sudden removal of bike parking infrastructure in Sunset Park.
evidence: Bike Rack complaints: 4 this week vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score 8.66, +1500%)
All complaints filed within single week window
Spike isolated to this metric; suggests localized rather than citywide issue
reporting_angles: Determine if complaints cluster geographically (waterfront vs. interior Sunset Park) to identify whether specific installations are damaged or missing
Contact DOT to learn if bike rack maintenance or removal work was scheduled in the district this week

themes_detail.label: Building/use code violations explode
themes_detail.summary: Over the past 2 weeks, Building/Use violations spiked to 161 complaints (2 weeks ago) vs. 7.0 weekly average (+2200%, z-score 40.1)—the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset—suggesting widespread illegal occupancy, unpermitted construction, or code enforcement action in Sunset Park.
evidence: Building/Use complaints: 161 (2 weeks ago) vs. 7.0 weekly average (z-score 40.1, +2200%)
Single highest z-score across all 311 spikes, indicating most anomalous deviation from baseline
652 total DOB building permits filed (last 90 days), including 54 new buildings and 462 alterations, suggesting active construction environment
reporting_angles: FOIA request to DOE to determine if complaints are concentrated in specific buildings, addresses, or neighborhoods; interview building inspectors about what triggered the spike
Cross-reference with DOB permit data to see if spike correlates with specific construction projects or a pattern of illegal conversions (illegal ADUs, rooming houses, etc.)
Interview community members in high-complaint buildings; investigate if this represents displacement pressure or new-construction-related violations

themes_detail.label: Street sweeping backlog emerges
themes_detail.summary: Last week, street sweeping complaints jumped to 10 vs. 0.9 weekly average (+1043%), indicating Sunset Park residents are reporting inadequate street cleaning—a possible signal of sanitation service degradation or lack of responsiveness.
evidence: Street Sweeping complaints: 10 last week vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score 8.66, +1043%)
Complements broader sanitation concerns: Dirty Condition complaints at 268 (90-day total), 5th most common complaint type
Street Condition complaints at 391 (90-day total) suggest infrastructure and cleanliness concerns overlap
reporting_angles: Check if DSNY has reduced sweeping schedules, diverted crews, or is understaffed in CD 307 this week
Map complaint locations to determine if spike is citywide or concentrated in specific Sunset Park neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Park noise and animal activity spike
themes_detail.summary: Last week, noise complaints in parks jumped to 4 vs. 0.2 weekly average (+1500%), and 2 weeks ago animal-in-park complaints reached 6 vs. 0.9 weekly average (+586%), suggesting seasonal park use surge, wildlife migration, or event activity in Sunset Park's green spaces.
evidence: Noise - Park complaints: 4 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score 8.66, +1500%)
Animal in a Park complaints: 6 (2 weeks ago) vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score 6.57, +586%)
Both spikes involve parks; correlates with Dead/Dying Tree and Dead Animal spikes, suggesting environmental or seasonal factor
reporting_angles: Identify which parks are generating complaints (Sunset Park waterfront, Prospect Park frontage, etc.) and what activities or animals residents are reporting
Interview Parks Dept on whether seasonal migration, new events, or park renovations are driving the activity surge
